import R47ParametricEventEDefectWindow
import R47ReusablePrefixBackfillCharge
import R47FutureBackfillOwnerPacking

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace ChompLean

/-!
R48: apply the prefix-exchange amortized bound to the parametric event-E
defect band.

For an adjacent actual-game dip, `k` old-prefix values missing from the new
prefix force at least `k+1` new-only values.  Every such value is a past
diagonal re-emitted on the new row, hence is high; its owner lies in the
strict upper half of the old row.  Owner packing therefore gives the general
bound `2*k+3 <= q`.

For event E, the last `delta+2` old-row columns contain the two high packet
hosts.  Removing them leaves exactly `delta` canonical lower slots.  R48
applies the general bound to the subfamily of those slots whose values are
actually absent from the new strict prefix.
-/

private theorem r48_nodup_map_of_injective_on
    {alpha beta : Type} [BEq alpha] [LawfulBEq alpha]
    [BEq beta] [LawfulBEq beta]
    (f : alpha -> beta) (xs : List alpha)
    (hxs : xs.Nodup)
    (hinj : ∀ x, x ∈ xs → ∀ y, y ∈ xs → f x = f y → x = y) :
    (xs.map f).Nodup := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hxs
      simp only [List.map_cons]
      rw [List.nodup_cons]
      constructor
      · intro hmem
        rcases List.mem_map.mp hmem with ⟨y, hy, hay⟩
        have hay' : a = y :=
          hinj a (by simp) y (by simp [hy]) hay.symm
        subst y
        exact hxs.1 hy
      · apply ih hxs.2
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        exact hinj x (by simp [hx]) y (by simp [hy]) hxy

/-- Actual-game amortized prefix-loss bound.  A family of `k` old strict
prefix values absent from the new strict prefix across a dip forces
`2*k+3 <= q`. -/
theorem game_adjacent_dip_forbidden_upper_half_bound
    {q : Nat} {forbidden : List Nat}
    (hdip : gameF (q + 1) (q + 1) < gameF q q)
    (hforbidden : forbidden.Nodup)
    (hsub : forbidden ⊆ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF q)
    (hmissing : ∀ v, v ∈ forbidden →
      v ∉ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (q + 1)) :
    2 * forbidden.length + 3 ≤ q := by
  let backfills := PrefixBackfillValues
    (StrictRowPrefixValues gameF q)
    (StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (q + 1))
  have hpackage := adjacent_dip_k_forbidden_force_k_succ_diagonal_backfills
    gameRecurrenceModel hdip hforbidden hsub hmissing
  change forbidden.length + 1 ≤ backfills.length ∧
      backfills.Nodup ∧
      ∀ v, v ∈ backfills → ∃ i, i < q ∧ gameF i i = v
    at hpackage
  rcases hpackage with ⟨hcount, hbackfillNodup, hownerExists⟩

  let owner : Nat -> Nat := fun v =>
    if hv : v ∈ backfills then Classical.choose (hownerExists v hv) else 0
  have howner : ∀ v, v ∈ backfills →
      owner v < q ∧ q < owner v + owner v ∧ gameF (owner v) (owner v) = v := by
    intro v hv
    have hchosen := Classical.choose_spec (hownerExists v hv)
    have hownerEq : owner v = Classical.choose (hownerExists v hv) := by
      dsimp [owner]
      rw [dif_pos hv]
    have hvFilter := List.mem_filter.mp hv
    have hvNew : v ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (q + 1) := hvFilter.1
    rcases mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hvNew with
      ⟨b, hb, hbValue⟩
    have hdiagValue : gameF (owner v) (owner v) = v := by
      rw [hownerEq]
      exact hchosen.2
    have hhigh := game_past_diagonal_reemission_is_high
      (i := owner v) (t := q + 1) (b := b)
      (Nat.le_of_lt hb) (hdiagValue.trans hbValue.symm)
    have hcap := recurrence_diagonal_source_capacity
      gameRecurrenceModel (owner v)
    change gameF (owner v) (owner v) ≤ owner v + owner v + 1 at hcap
    exact ⟨by rw [hownerEq]; exact hchosen.1, by omega, hdiagValue⟩
  have hownerInj : ∀ v, v ∈ backfills → ∀ w, w ∈ backfills →
      owner v = owner w → v = w := by
    intro v hv w hw how
    have hvEq := (howner v hv).2.2
    have hwEq := (howner w hw).2.2
    rw [how] at hvEq
    exact hvEq.symm.trans hwEq
  have hownersNodup : (backfills.map owner).Nodup :=
    r48_nodup_map_of_injective_on owner backfills
      hbackfillNodup hownerInj
  have hownersHalf : ∀ i, i ∈ backfills.map owner →
      i < q ∧ q < i + i := by
    intro i hi
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hi with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(howner v hv).1, (howner v hv).2.1⟩
  have hqPos : 0 < q := by
    have hnextHigh := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt (q + 1)
    have hcap := recurrence_diagonal_source_capacity gameRecurrenceModel q
    change q + 1 < gameF (q + 1) (q + 1) at hnextHigh
    change gameF q q ≤ q + q + 1 at hcap
    omega
  have hpack := nodup_strict_upper_half_length_bound
    hqPos hownersNodup hownersHalf
  simp only [List.length_map] at hpack
  omega

/-- The canonical local defect band: the last `delta+2` old-row columns,
with the two high packet columns removed. -/
def EventEDefectBandSlots
    (s delta c b0 : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range' (s - delta - 2) (delta + 2)).erase c).erase b0

/-- The subfamily of canonical defect-band columns whose old values are
absent from the new strict prefix. -/
noncomputable def EventEMissingBandSlots
    (s delta c b0 : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0).filter (fun g =>
    !(decide (gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1))))

/-- The complete quantitative certificate carried by the canonical event-E
defect band. -/
def EventEMissingBandAmortizedCertificate
    (s delta z c b0 : Nat) : Prop :=
  c < s ∧ b0 < s ∧ c ≠ b0 ∧
    gameF s c = z + 1 ∧ gameF s b0 = z ∧
    (EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0).Nodup ∧
    (EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0).length = delta ∧
    (∀ g, g ∈ EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0 →
      g < s ∧ g ≠ c ∧ g ≠ b0 ∧ EventELowerTransition s z g) ∧
    2 * (EventEMissingBandSlots s delta c b0).length + 3 ≤ s

/-- In a parametric event E, the canonical band contains exactly `delta`
lower slots.  If `m` of their old values disappear from the new strict
prefix, then the actual-game owner packing law gives `2*m+3 <= s`. -/
theorem gameF_margin_eventE_missing_band_amortized_bound
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s : Nat}
    (hdip : gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) < gameF s s)
    (hmargin : s = 0 ∨
      ∃ j, s = j + 1 ∧
        RMax gameRecurrenceModel j < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1)
    (hnextDip :
      gameF (s + 2) (s + 2) < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)) :
    let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
    let delta := 2 * s - d
    let z := d - 1
    ∃ c b0, EventEMissingBandAmortizedCertificate s delta z c b0 := by
  dsimp only
  let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
  let delta := 2 * s - d
  let z := d - 1
  have hInv := gameF_margin_eventE_parametric_defect_invariant
    hU hdip hmargin hnextDip
  change EventEDefectPacketInvariant s d delta z at hInv
  rcases hInv with
    ⟨_hdeltaPos, hdeltaUpper, _hdeltaSum, _hzDiag,
      c, b0, _b1, _dc, _d0, _d1,
      hc, hb0, _hb1, hcNe, _hbNe, hSucc, hBase, _hHost1,
      hcWindow, hb0Window, _hb1Window,
      _hdc, _hd0, _hd1, _hcOffset, _hb0Offset, _hb1Offset,
      hTransitions⟩
  let band := List.range' (s - delta - 2) (delta + 2)
  let slots := EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0
  let missing := EventEMissingBandSlots s delta c b0
  have hbandNodup : band.Nodup := by
    dsimp [band]
    exact List.nodup_range' 1
  have hbandEnd : (s - delta - 2) + (delta + 2) = s := by
    omega
  have hcBand : c ∈ band := by
    apply List.mem_range'_1.mpr
    dsimp [band]
    constructor <;> omega
  have hb0Band : b0 ∈ band := by
    apply List.mem_range'_1.mpr
    dsimp [band]
    constructor <;> omega
  have hb0AfterC : b0 ∈ band.erase c := by
    exact (List.mem_erase_of_ne hcNe.symm).mpr hb0Band
  have hafterCNodup : (band.erase c).Nodup := hbandNodup.erase c
  have hslotsNodup : slots.Nodup := by
    change ((band.erase c).erase b0).Nodup
    exact hafterCNodup.erase b0
  have hslotsLen : slots.length = delta := by
    have hcLen := List.length_erase_of_mem hcBand
    have hbLen := List.length_erase_of_mem hb0AfterC
    change ((band.erase c).erase b0).length = delta
    rw [hbLen, hcLen]
    dsimp [band]
    simp only [List.length_range']
    omega
  have hslotsProps : ∀ g, g ∈ slots →
      g < s ∧ g ≠ c ∧ g ≠ b0 ∧ EventELowerTransition s z g := by
    intro g hg
    have hg' : g ∈ (band.erase c).erase b0 := by
      exact hg
    have houter := (hafterCNodup.mem_erase_iff).mp hg'
    have hinner := (hbandNodup.mem_erase_iff).mp houter.2
    have hgBand := List.mem_range'_1.mp hinner.2
    have hgs : g < s := by
      omega
    exact ⟨hgs, hinner.1, houter.1,
      hTransitions g hgs hinner.1 houter.1⟩

  have hmissingNodup : missing.Nodup := by
    exact List.filter_sublist.nodup hslotsNodup
  let forbidden := missing.map (fun g => gameF s g)
  have hforbiddenNodup : forbidden.Nodup := by
    apply r48_nodup_map_of_injective_on (fun g => gameF s g)
      missing hmissingNodup
    intro g hg k hk heq
    have hgSlots : g ∈ slots := (List.mem_filter.mp hg).1
    have hkSlots : k ∈ slots := (List.mem_filter.mp hk).1
    have hgs := (hslotsProps g hgSlots).1
    have hks := (hslotsProps k hkSlots).1
    exact gameRecurrenceModel.fixed_q_injective
      (Nat.le_of_lt hgs) (Nat.le_of_lt hks) heq
  have hforbiddenSub : forbidden ⊆ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF s := by
    intro v hv
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hv with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    have hgSlots : g ∈ slots := (List.mem_filter.mp hg).1
    have hgs := (hslotsProps g hgSlots).1
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨g, List.mem_range.mpr hgs, rfl⟩
  have hforbiddenMissing : ∀ v, v ∈ forbidden →
      v ∉ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1) := by
    intro v hv
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hv with ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    have hfilter := (List.mem_filter.mp hg).2
    simpa [missing, EventEMissingBandSlots] using hfilter
  have hamortized := game_adjacent_dip_forbidden_upper_half_bound
    hdip hforbiddenNodup hforbiddenSub hforbiddenMissing
  have hmissingBound : 2 * missing.length + 3 ≤ s := by
    simpa [forbidden] using hamortized
  refine ⟨c, b0, ?_⟩
  change EventEMissingBandAmortizedCertificate s delta z c b0
  exact ⟨hc, hb0, hcNe, hSucc, hBase,
    hslotsNodup, hslotsLen, hslotsProps, hmissingBound⟩

/-- Large-defect corollary.  If the `delta` canonical lower slots do not fit
under the loss bound (`s < 2*delta+3`), at least one of their values must be
present in the new strict prefix.  Thus the whole large-defect/no-rehost
subclass is impossible. -/
theorem gameF_margin_eventE_large_defect_forces_band_rehost
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s : Nat}
    (hdip : gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) < gameF s s)
    (hmargin : s = 0 ∨
      ∃ j, s = j + 1 ∧
        RMax gameRecurrenceModel j < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1)
    (hnextDip :
      gameF (s + 2) (s + 2) < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)) :
    let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
    let delta := 2 * s - d
    let z := d - 1
    s < 2 * delta + 3 →
      ∃ c b0 g,
        gameF s c = z + 1 ∧ gameF s b0 = z ∧
        g ∈ EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0 ∧
        g < s ∧ g ≠ c ∧ g ≠ b0 ∧
        gameF s g < z ∧
        C gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) (gameF s g) := by
  dsimp only
  let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
  let delta := 2 * s - d
  let z := d - 1
  intro hlarge
  have hcert := gameF_margin_eventE_missing_band_amortized_bound
    hU hdip hmargin hnextDip
  change ∃ c b0,
    EventEMissingBandAmortizedCertificate s delta z c b0 at hcert
  rcases hcert with ⟨c, b0, hcertificate⟩
  rcases hcertificate with
    ⟨_hc, _hb0, _hcNe, hSucc, hBase,
      hslotsNodup, hslotsLen, hslotsProps, hmissingBound⟩
  let slots := EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0
  let missing := EventEMissingBandSlots s delta c b0
  have hpresent : ∃ g, g ∈ slots ∧
      gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1) := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnone
    have hallAbsent : ∀ g, g ∈ slots →
        gameF s g ∉ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1) := by
      intro g hg hmem
      apply hnone
      exact ⟨g, hg, hmem⟩
    have hslotsSub : slots ⊆ missing := by
      intro g hg
      change g ∈ slots.filter (fun x =>
        !(decide (gameF s x ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1))))
      apply List.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨hg, ?_⟩
      simpa using hallAbsent g hg
    have hlen := nodup_subset_length_le hslotsNodup hslotsSub
    change slots.length ≤ missing.length at hlen
    change slots.length = delta at hslotsLen
    change 2 * missing.length + 3 ≤ s at hmissingBound
    omega
  rcases hpresent with ⟨g, hgSlots, hgNew⟩
  have hgData := hslotsProps g hgSlots
  have hLower : gameF s g < z := by
    have htransition := hgData.2.2.2
    simpa [EventELowerTransition] using htransition.2.1
  have hgC : C gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) (gameF s g) :=
    mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hgNew
  exact ⟨c, b0, g, hSucc, hBase, hgSlots,
    hgData.1, hgData.2.1, hgData.2.2.1, hLower, hgC⟩

#print axioms game_adjacent_dip_forbidden_upper_half_bound
#print axioms gameF_margin_eventE_missing_band_amortized_bound
#print axioms gameF_margin_eventE_large_defect_forces_band_rehost

end ChompLean
